color.note: Light sections and dark sections alternate down a page. Set a dark band with data-theme="dark" on its section. Lemon is the only accent and means: act here, or this one is active.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page ground for plain sections and dark bands. Also the label colour on a hovered CTA tab.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Ground under the graph-paper grid. Always paired with grid-line.

tokens.name: grid-line
tokens.usage: Graph-paper rules on paper. Lighter than the paper in light, so the grid reads as texture.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Text nodes, chips, and the hover fill of links and arrow buttons.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text on ground, paper and surface. The border of arrow buttons and the hover fill of CTA tabs.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: node model names, hints, counts. 4.5:1 or more on ground, paper and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: The resting half of a split headline and inactive scroll-spy items. Display sizes only (24px and up): 3:1 on paper and ground in both themes.

tokens.name: lemon
tokens.usage: The one accent: CTA tabs, the toggle track, header bands, a hovered chip, the active scroll-spy item on a dark band. Never text on a light ground.

tokens.name: on-light
tokens.usage: Text and marks on the fills that stay light in both themes: lemon, sage, eggshell and media.

tokens.name: connector
tokens.usage: Node connector curves and port discs. Decorative: never the only carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: The footer slab.

tokens.name: eggshell
tokens.usage: Body of the prompt card.

tokens.name: media
tokens.usage: Placeholder fill where an image or video will go.

type.note: One family at one weight. Size, case and tracking carry the hierarchy. Display sizes are the 1440px values; bundle.css scales them with clamp().

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Section headlines, split headlines, the scroll-spy list. Fluid: clamp(44px, 6.53vw, 94px).

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: The nav CTA at the top of the page, the name in the footer, a split headline inside a pinned section.

styles.name: intro
styles.sample: Turn a creative brief into a repeatable workflow.
styles.usage: Intros under a headline (three lines, 46ch max), chip labels, arrow glyphs.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Each node takes an input, runs one model or tool, and passes its output on.
styles.usage: Any text longer than three lines.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: A glass loom on a pale bench, soft light from the left.
styles.usage: Text inside nodes and cards, placeholder captions, the footer's about line.

groups.name: Labels
groups.note: Always uppercase. bundle.css sets text-transform on both classes.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Nav and footer links, header bands, the compact CTA, node kinds, tags, hints and counts.

styles.name: label-wide
styles.usage: Node model names and the copyright line.

spacing.note: Five steps on the source's rem (14.4px at 1440): 0.5, 1, 2, 4.5 and 11. Exact values, not snapped to 8.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Inset of tags, chips (vertical), nav links, the toggle and panels; gap between cards in a panel and between a node header and its body.

tokens.name: space-s
tokens.usage: Card and canvas inset, chip horizontal padding, the page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-m
tokens.usage: Gap between cards, between footer columns, between a headline and its intro.

tokens.name: space-l
tokens.usage: Page gutter at 1440, footer slab padding, gap between the parts of the footer.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Space from the nav to a hero headline and between major sections.

tokens.name: grid-cell
tokens.usage: One graph-paper square.

radius.note: Square by default. Corners round only on media, nodes, chips, panels, and the one inward corner of a CTA tab or the footer slab.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Link hover fills and tags.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Images, nodes, chips, cards, the canvas, arrow buttons, and the corner of small and large CTA tabs.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: A panel that holds cards (radius-m plus the space-xs inset).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The one rounded corner of the footer slab and of the extra-large CTA tab.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The toggle track and knob.

shadow.note: No elevation shadows. Surfaces separate by value and by the grid.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: 2px of ground, then 2px of solid ink (light) or lemon (dark).

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Dimming siblings, fading out an outgoing image, a scroll-spy colour change.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Chip fill, fading in an incoming image, press scale.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Every other hover: CTA tabs, links, arrows, the split headline emphasis.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Movement: the toggle knob, carousel slides, the active card scale, reveal on scroll.

tokens.name: ease-out-quad
tokens.usage: Colour, fill and opacity changes. Matches GSAP power1.out.

tokens.name: ease-out-cubic
tokens.usage: Anything that moves. Matches GSAP power2.out.

tokens.name: opacity-dim
tokens.usage: Siblings of the hovered chip.
